name: OPC Energy Ltd.
summary: OPC Energy Ltd. engages in the development, construction, operation, generation, and supply of electricity and energy in Israel. The company operates through three segments: Israel, US Renewable Energies, and US Energy Transition. It produces and supplies electricity to private customers. The company generates electricity from solar, wind, and water or waste.
